items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Willie, what's his Willie name? Willie Joseph. Oh, Kaiser.

ctx.x: Willie, I don't know which Willie that is.
Willie, what's his Willie name? Willie Joseph. Oh, Kaiser. Yeah, that's his name, Willie. I don't know him. He came right back from California, come right and got killed.
Well, his brother told me about that.
